name: Jukebox
author: CraftPy
description: A media player on your own computer: your OGG, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and FLAC files from pyforge/shared/music, the music of the game, resource packs and mods, and note block melodies. Keeps playing when the window is closed; nearby players can hear it too.

apps.name: Jukebox
apps.description: Play your music, the music of the game and note block melodies.
